name: Karl-Christian Wolff-Ingham

hero.tagline: Design leadership at the intersection of product, technology and business.

summary:
Multidisciplinary design leader with a career built on connecting those perspectives. Bringing the system, the user, the business, and the technology into one frame. As AI changes how expertise is applied, the ability to integrate those perspectives becomes increasingly key. That has been the through line of my career, most often through the lens of design and product strategy.

Proven track record building and maturing design organizations, product execution and coaching, delivering measurable business growth, and leading at the intersection of emerging technology and product strategy at Fortune companies and in consulting. Experience spans media, finance, e-commerce, and consulting sectors.

experience.title: Senior Director & Head of UX Design and Research · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Executive design leader leading UX design and research for Fortune Global 500 automotive/industrial parts distribution leader.
bullets: Leading research-driven redesign of <hotspot key="gpc-revenue">$8B unified commerce platform</hotspot> and <hotspot key="agentic">AI-driven (agentic) new product</hotspot>, informed by prior consulting engagement.
Developed <hotspot key="bolt">"Bolt" global design system</hotspot> adopted across North America, Europe, and APAC.
Introduced balanced team model embedding dedicated design and research roles in agile pods, supported by a scalable design process integrating stakeholder engagement and user research.
Pioneered early 2025 assessment of and subsequent introduction of AI design and prototyping tool (v0) to optimize for exploration breadth and execution speed.

experience.title: Founder & Principal Consultant · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Boutique product and design consultancy bridging strategy and execution for clients across fitness, media analytics, and automotive sectors.
bullets: Conducted yearlong research and strategic foresight engagement for GPC CIO on the future of automotive retail and repair, including primary research and journey mapping across drivers, repair shops, parts stores, and supply chain. Work directly informed the company's digital transformation roadmap and led to recruitment as Head of UX Design and Research.
Redesigned FitRadio's workout music streaming app. Product coaching for Comscore. Mobile app heuristic design evaluation for Gold's Gym.

experience.company: TRUIST (SunTrust prior to SunTrust BB&T Merger)
experience.title: Head of UX Design & Research · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Inherited a 10-person nascent UX team at SunTrust with no research or UI capability and no independent design voice; established UI and Research as new functions and scaled to around 30 by the time of the $66B SunTrust-BB&T merger, then continued the build-out to a 50-person multidisciplinary organization across the merged Truist entity, establishing an evidence-based design methodology.
bullets: Rebooted and repositioned the <hotspot key="merger">SunTrust Innovation Accelerator Studio</hotspot>, introducing service design, customer journey mapping and strategic foresight as core capabilities. Partnered with Corporate Strategy on a foresight exercise - presenting three future-of-banking scenarios to CEO and C-Suite; CEO called the work "instrumental" in shaping merger strategy.
Led UX design and research across Consumer Banking, Small Business, Wealth Management, Small Business and Commercial Banking for SunTrust and Small Business and Commercial Banking for Truist.

Rebuilt all business <hotspot key="truist-products">products</hotspot> for the merged entity (commercial and small business banking). Integrated design into Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) to deliver a unified experience across all products.
Translated the new Truist brand into visual design and UI standards, defining the Truist design system deployed across all digital products.

experience.title: UX Design Practice Leader, Experience Design · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Led UX and emerging interactions practice for Sparks Grove, North Highland's design and innovation agency. Served Fortune 500 clients including <hotspot key="clients">Delta Air Lines, The Coca-Cola Company, Disney, Universal Studios, T-Mobile, and The Home Depot</hotspot>.
bullets: Led transformation of agency from traditional waterfall delivery to agile software development and lean product management, repositioning the practice around "Human Experience Design" (HxD). Earned National Impact Award (2016) for the transformation.

Key engagements included building <hotspot key="delta">news.delta.com</hotspot> for Delta Air Lines and consulting with The Home Depot for lean product development and design in their enterprise product organization.

experience.title: Vice President, Product & UX · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Led product management and product design for <hotspot key="upwave">upwave</hotspot>, Turner's IoT- driven digital health venture at the intersection of quantified-self technologies (wearables, health trackers) and personalized content delivery. Partnered with IDEO on initial market validation and product-market fit.
bullets: Took venture from concept to 1M monthly unique users, 27K registered users, and 9.5M visits in 8 months. Introduced lean product methodology enabling daily release cycles, and increased site recirculation from 5% to 24%.
Product nominated for Webby Award (Health & Fitness). Venture was ahead of mainstream wearables adoption (pre-Apple Watch) and sunset when Turner exited the health vertical.

experience.title: Senior Director, Strategic Product · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: Led multi-disciplinary (Product, UX, Engineering) R&D team driving innovation across emerging platforms for CNN, Cartoon Network, TBS, and TNT.
bullets: <hotspot key="emmy">Emmy Award</hotspot> (Outstanding Creative Achievement in Interactive Media) by developing the underlying automatic content recognition (ACR) platform that powered the Team Coco sync-to-TV application.
Awarded two <hotspot key="patents">U.S. patents</hotspot> for automatic content recognition and audience engagement technologies that synchronized interactive content with live broadcast television.

Designed and led development for CNN World Cup Twitter Buzz, producing real-time data visualization that earned a <hotspot key="rts-award">Royal Television Society Award</hotspot> and Fast Company's "Infographic of the Day".

experience.title: Director, Games & Entertainment Technology · Atlanta, GA
experience.description: R&D exploration role focused on piloting and promoting emerging platforms into Turner brands (CNN, Cartoon Network, TBS, TNT) prior to mainstream adoption.
bullets: Pioneered the first <hotspot key="ar">mobile augmented reality applications</hotspot> in the U.S. for NBA and Cartoon Network in an academic partnership with Georgia Tech. Built on pre-iPhone Nokia devices, successfully predicting mobile's path to AR preeminence.

Scouted and brokered Perceptive Pixel's large-format multi-touch technology into CNN News after meeting founder Jeff Han at his breakthrough TED2006 presentation; Turner R&D then designed and built CNN's <hotspot key="magicwall">"Magic Wall" weather application</hotspot> with CNN Weather.

Led <hotspot key="fusionfall">behavioral design research for Cartoon Network's FusionFall</hotspot> with Immersyve and Richard Ryan, co-author of Self-Determination Theory and one of the world's most-cited psychologists, translating motivation science into decisions about onboarding, challenge, exploration, social play, and retention.
Established virtual item sales as an incremental revenue stream for Cartoon Network and Adult Swim properties on Sony PlayStation Home's early virtual economies.
Prototyped early cloud-streaming games technology for GameTap using instant-on video technology, a precursor to services such as Google Stadia and Nvidia GeForce Now.

experience.title: Interactive TV Architect · Portland, OR / London, UK
experience.description: Ensequence was the dominant interactive TV software platform from the US, powering interactive shows and commercials across more than 20 million homes worldwide. Client roster included NBCUniversal, ESPN, MTV Networks, HBO, BSkyB, BBC.
bullets: UK product manager for the "on-Q" Interactive TV Authoring System.
Designed, engineered, and deployed solutions and applications for broadcast deployments for major clients.

experience.title: Solutions Development Manager · London, UK
experience.description: Founding team member of Two Way TV, a world-leading interactive television pioneer that operated dedicated gaming channels across the UK's major digital platforms and internationally in the US/Canada and Australia. The company held key interactive TV patents, and signed a strategic alliance with Microsoft to bring the technology to the MSTV platform.
bullets: Designed, produced, and technically architected "Armchair Manager - Football," including its database. It became the first interactive television game ever nominated in the <hotspot key="bafta">BAFTA Sports category</hotspot> (2000).

Pioneered the UK's first <hotspot key="two-way-games">interactive television multiplayer game service</hotspot> and a global first with the Challenge TV fully interactive network. All games playable live alongside in studio participants.

experience.title: Interactive Designer, Children's and Education Team · Brighton, UK
experience.description: A UK interactive-multimedia pioneer of the CD-ROM and Philips CD-i era (CD-i being one of the earliest serious attempts at interactive television in the home). Designed and produced "The Violent Earth" (educational CD-ROM, Mac and PC) and "<hotspot key="felix">Felix the Cat's GIANT Electronic Comic Book</hotspot>" (PC and Philips CD-i).

experience.title: Multimedia Developer · UK
experience.description: An early-career role in educational interactive multimedia, concurrent with undergraduate Computer Science studies at the University of Brighton. Designed and developed "Emphasis on Physical Geography," a prototype educational application for Mac.

education.school: Brown University & IE Business School, US & Spain
education.focus: Focus: Strategic management, innovation, and global business
Focus: Human Computer Interaction AI and Intelligent Tutoring Systems. <hotspot key="apple-award">Apple Design Project Award</hotspot> winner.
Dissertation: <hotspot key="dissertation">“Colonizing Cyberspace”</hotspot>. Built <hotspot key="backprop">neural network capabilities</hotspot> for HyperCard.

patentsAndRecognition.patents: Automatic content recognition systems, audience engagement technologies
